writes a known network's genesis files, without opening any store

Usage: dolos config write-genesis [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --network <NAME>   A known network; without it, the configuration's network, and no
                         configuration is read when it is given
      --dir <PATH>       The directory the files are written to, created if missing [default:
                         ./genesis]
      --force            Overwrite files that already exist
  -c, --config <CONFIG>  
  -h, --help             Print help
